verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only a docs page titled "API Access & Keys", with nothing indicating those keys can be scoped, permission-limited, or issued per agent. The "fine-grained admin controls" and RBAC claims cover user and workspace permissions, a related but different control that earns no credit for least-privilege API credentials. No scoping capability is documented, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
